form.title: Exclude interval from training
form.confirm: Exclude {interval} from this source-volume baseline. The detected incident span is already excluded automatically. Extend the UTC bounds only if nearby buckets were also affected. This takes effect after the next baseline rebuild, may make the expected range unavailable, and does not change this anomaly or its alerts.
form.format: Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, in UTC. Bounds align to the source's {minutes}-minute bucket width.
form.widenOnly: Start can only move earlier and end only later; the detected span is {interval}. The interval can be at most {days} days.
form.reasonHelp: Required, 1 to {max} characters. It is kept with the exclusion and in the incident's activity.
form.needsWiden: Widen the interval to include nearby buckets. The detected span is already excluded automatically.
form.needsReason: Enter a reason of 1 to {max} characters.

problem.start-unreadable: Start is not a UTC time in the form YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
problem.end-unreadable: End is not a UTC time in the form YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
problem.unaligned: Start and end must fall on the source's {minutes}-minute bucket boundaries.
problem.start-later: Start cannot be later than the detected span's start, {time}.
problem.end-earlier: End cannot be earlier than the detected span's end, {time}.
problem.too-long: The interval can be at most {days} days.
problem.not-widened: Widen the interval to include nearby buckets. The detected span is already excluded automatically.

form.forbidden: Recording an exclusion needs the {permission} permission.
form.gone: The anomaly no longer exists. Reload the page.

result.PENDING_REBUILD: Pending next baseline rebuild. The expected range has not changed.
result.APPLIED: This exact interval was already excluded and a baseline rebuild has applied it.
result.OUTSIDE_LOOKBACK: This exact interval was already excluded. It is older than the baseline lookback and changes nothing.

list.heading: Baseline training exclusions

list.empty: No analyst training exclusions affect this baseline.

list.forbidden: Reading training exclusions needs the {permission} permission.
list.caption: Analyst training exclusions
list.revokeIntro: Revoke the exclusion of {interval}. The interval returns to training at the next baseline rebuild, except where an incident span is excluded automatically.
list.revoked: Exclusion revoked. The interval returns to training at the next baseline rebuild.
list.revokeNeedsPermission: Revoking an exclusion needs the {permission} permission.
